answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by letting standing fade like a voyage that never returns to harbor: every identity's standing expires unless renewed each epoch with fresh graded work of its own. One good answer cannot carry a thousand heads, because each head must climb its own summit again, producing new original work mapped against the whole atlas of what came before. Every extra fake then costs one fresh graded answer per epoch, forever, so a farm pays in original work for every head it keeps alive.
